title: feat(status-pages): themeable public page with a live editor preview

summaries.body:
## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 8/10** · likely safe to merge The required `theme` on the snapshot page breaks snapshots written before this deploy, and no test decodes a pre-theme snapshot. 1 warning −1 · 1 note · tests covered · risk high −1 Replaces a status page's `brand_color` with a full `theme` (preset, appearance, colours, radius, font): a backfilled jsonb column, a v2 `theme` field, 4.5:1 contrast validation, and an editor Appearance section with a sandboxed preview. Mergeable once snapshots already in edge storage keep serving. - `StatusPageTheme` replaces `brandColor` in `status_pages.theme` and the v2 API - `validateTheme` refuses non-hex colours and text below 4.5:1 contrast - `resolveSafeTheme` renders presets into CSS variables for auto, light or dark - The editor gains an Appearance section with a sandboxed live preview ### Before merge - [ ] **Migration** · Check it is safe on production data and with the code still deployed · [`packages/db/drizzle/20261028183756_status_page_theme/migration.sql`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/3f07385947244feb4ed55dfb14081da89123f855/packages/db/drizzle/20261028183756_status_page_theme/migration.sql) - [ ] **Manual** · Apply the `packages/db/drizzle/20261028183756_status_page_theme` migration with the prd alchemy deploy; it drops `brand_color` ### Findings
🟠 Warning · F1 · Snapshots published before this deploy no longer decode (theme replaced brandColor at version 1) correctness · [`packages/domain/src/status-page.ts:405`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/3f07385947244feb4ed55dfb14081da89123f855/packages/domain/src/status-page.ts#L405) `STATUS_PAGE_SNAPSHOT_VERSION` stays 1 while the page payload now requires `theme` and drops `brandColor`, so every snapshot already in KV/R2 fails `decodeStatusPageSnapshotJson` (`packages/domain/src/status-page.ts:722`). `loadView` then returns none and the status worker answers 503 "Service unavailable" (`apps/status/src/handler.ts:155-157`) for each existing page until the minutely publisher sweep republishes it, up to `STATUS_PAGE_REPUBLISH_AFTER_MS` (15 minutes). Keep the reader tolerant of the old shape (decode `theme` as optional and fall back to `DEFAULT_STATUS_PAGE_THEME`), or bump the version and republish the snapshots as part of the deploy. ``` Decode `theme` as `Schema.optionalKey(StatusPageTheme)` in `StatusPageSnapshotPage` and default it in `packages/status-page/src/document.ts`, so snapshots written by the previous release keep serving. ```
🔵 Note · F2 · The preview rebuilds and reloads the whole page document on every keystroke performance · [`apps/web/src/page/alerts/status-pages/editor/view-appearance.ts:389`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/3f07385947244feb4ed55dfb14081da89123f855/apps/web/src/page/alerts/status-pages/editor/view-appearance.ts#L389) `previewDocument` renders every component's 90 day bars and every incident into a fresh HTML string on each view pass, and the result replaces the iframe's `srcdoc`, so the browser re-parses the document, refetches the logo and resets the preview's scroll once per character typed in any Settings field. Render it once per distinct draft (memoize on `form`, `model.previewScheme`) or debounce the form to document step. ``` Cache the last rendered document keyed by the draft that produced it, and only hand a new string to `h.Srcdoc` when it differs. ```
What was checked - `validateBrandColor` only ever stored `^#[0-9a-f]{6}$` values, so the migration's backfill regex matches every existing row - Hostile theme strings cannot reach CSS: `validateHex` refuses them and `safeTheme`/`safeColor` drop them, pinned by `render.test.ts:354` - Every preset clears 4.5:1 in every appearance, pinned by `status-page.test.ts:373`, so a preset-only save is not refused
`3f07385` · Updated on every push. Reply "won't fix" to dismiss a finding, or mention @maple-review-bot to ask about one.

## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 7/10** · likely safe to merge Theme validation passes themes whose accent links and derived muted text still fail AA, and the PR ships a destructive `brand_color` drop plus an API v2 contract change. 2 warnings −2 · 1 note · tests covered · risk high −1 Adds a per-page theme (preset, appearance, colour overrides, radius, font) replacing `brand_color`, published in the snapshot, with a WCAG gate and a live editor preview built on the real renderer. Two contrast gaps leave parts of an approved theme below AA. - `StatusPageTheme` replaces `brand_color` on the row, API and snapshot - Editor Appearance section blocks saving on a WCAG contrast failure - Live preview renders the public page in a sandboxed iframe - Fresh page and incident reads now re-read the editor clock ### Before merge - [ ] **Migration** · Check it is safe on production data and with the code still deployed · [`packages/db/drizzle/20261028183756_status_page_theme/migration.sql`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/6c0a0cffc7c8b82ec92da4f78f47d5dc767d1c2b/packages/db/drizzle/20261028183756_status_page_theme/migration.sql) - [ ] **Manual** · Confirm nothing outside this PR still reads `status_pages.brand_color` before the drop applies in the prd deploy ### Findings
🟠 Warning · F3 · --accent skips the readability check, so unreadable accents still paint links correctness · [`packages/status-page/src/styles.ts:21`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/6c0a0cffc7c8b82ec92da4f78f47d5dc767d1c2b/packages/status-page/src/styles.ts#L21) `accentVariable` emits `--accent` from `theme.accent` for the whole document, while `withAccent` (`packages/domain/src/status-page.ts:345`) guards the accent against each mode's background only for `--link`. `.site` (line 30) and `footer a` (line 41) colour themselves with `var(--accent,var(--muted))`, so a stored accent of `#a5b4fc` on a forced light Default page paints the site and footer links at 1.99:1 — the exact case `status-page.test.ts:392` expects to fall back from. Emit the accent per scheme from the already-guarded token (add it to `StatusPageThemeTokens` and set it in `withAccent`), or use `var(--link)` in those two selectors. ``` Make the accent a per-mode token guarded like `--link`: add `accent` to `StatusPageThemeTokens`, set it in `withAccent` next to `link`, and emit `--accent` inside `tokenVariables` for each scheme (media query included) instead of once in the root rule. ```
🟠 Warning · F4 · Muted text derived from a text override lands far below AA correctness · [`packages/domain/src/status-page.ts:333`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/6c0a0cffc7c8b82ec92da4f78f47d5dc767d1c2b/packages/domain/src/status-page.ts#L333) `mixHex(fg, bg, 0.62)` always pulls the muted colour toward the background, whatever contrast remains. With `text: #767676` on white — accepted, and pinned as passing, by `themeContrastIssue` at 4.54:1 (`packages/domain/src/status-page.test.ts:451`) — `muted` becomes `#aaaaaa` at 2.32:1, and `--muted` paints the section headers, timestamps, component descriptions and footer (`packages/status-page/src/styles.ts:36`, `:38`, `:40`, `:60`, `:64`). A theme passes validation with most of its secondary text unreadable; blend only as far toward the background as `STATUS_PAGE_MIN_CONTRAST` allows, or check `muted` against `bg` and `card` in `themeContrastIssue`. ``` Derive `muted` by stepping the blend weight down from 1 toward the background and keeping the last value that still clears `contrastRatio(muted, bg) >= STATUS_PAGE_MIN_CONTRAST` (and likewise on `card`), so a theme that passes validation keeps all of its text above AA. ```
### Still open from earlier reviews - 🔵 **Note** · F2 · The preview rebuilds and reloads the whole page document on every keystroke · [`apps/web/src/page/alerts/status-pages/editor/view-appearance.ts:389`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/6c0a0cffc7c8b82ec92da4f78f47d5dc767d1c2b/apps/web/src/page/alerts/status-pages/editor/view-appearance.ts#L389)
What was checked - `withAccent` drops an unreadable accent from `--link`, per mode (`packages/domain/src/status-page.ts:345`) - Clock re-read after page and incident reads is `ReadStatusPageClock` (`editor/command.ts:30`) - Pre-theme snapshots decode to the default theme, pinned by `status-page.test.ts:107`

## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 8/10** · likely safe to merge F3 and F4 are genuinely fixed at this head; the one remaining hole is muted text when only the card colour is overridden. 1 warning −1 · 1 note · tests covered · risk high −1 The follow-up commits close both earlier theme findings: accents reach CSS only through guarded `--link`/`--secondary`, and muted text is now the readable mix. One gap remains: a card-only override leaves the preset's muted text on the new card colour. - `withAccent` derives a per-mode `secondary`, so no unguarded `--accent` is emitted - `readableMix` steps muted toward the text colour until it clears AA on background and card - `snapshot.page.theme` decodes with a default, so pre-theme snapshots still render ### Before merge - [ ] **Migration** · Check it is safe on production data and with the code still deployed · [`packages/db/drizzle/20261028183756_status_page_theme/migration.sql`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/369c0e2c043f1d4824d99c2fce64788a65ca427e/packages/db/drizzle/20261028183756_status_page_theme/migration.sql) ### Findings
🟠 Warning · F5 · A card-only override leaves the preset's muted painted on the new card colour correctness · [`packages/domain/src/status-page.ts:349`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/369c0e2c043f1d4824d99c2fce64788a65ca427e/packages/domain/src/status-page.ts#L349) `muted` is only re-derived when `background` or `text` is set, so overriding just the card keeps the preset's muted while `.card` and `.components` now paint `var(--card)` behind incident dates and component descriptions (`packages/status-page/src/styles.ts:30`, `:45`). With `appearance: "light"`, `card: "#c0c0c0"` and no text override, `themeContrastIssue` passes (text on cards is 10.88:1) but the muted dates render at 3.16:1; `card: "#808080"` gives 1.45:1. Recompute when `theme.card` is set too — `readableMix` already checks both background and card. ``` const muted = theme.background === null && theme.text === null && theme.card === null ? tokens.muted : readableMix(fg, bg, card) ```
### Still open from earlier reviews - 🔵 **Note** · F2 · The preview rebuilds and reloads the whole page document on every keystroke · [`apps/web/src/page/alerts/status-pages/editor/view-appearance.ts:389`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/369c0e2c043f1d4824d99c2fce64788a65ca427e/apps/web/src/page/alerts/status-pages/editor/view-appearance.ts#L389) ### Fixed since the last review - ✅ ~~F3 · `--accent` skips the readability check, so unreadable accents still paint links~~ - ✅ ~~F4 · Muted text derived from a text override lands far below AA~~
What was checked - No `--accent` left in `packages/status-page`; accent only feeds guarded `link`/`secondary` (`theme.ts:40`, `status-page.ts:364`) - Card-only override contrast computed with the new mix code: 3.16:1 muted on `#c0c0c0`, validation passes - Every preset's muted text clears AA on its own background and card
`369c0e2` · Updated on every push. Reply "won't fix" to dismiss a finding, or mention @maple-review-bot to ask about one.


> [!WARNING]
